name: Paging Console — Assign Emergency Button
description: When an alarm armed MQTT message arrives, dynamically update slot 1 on the paging console panel to the Emergency All-Call action. The paging_console_button action GETs the current page layout, patches the target slot with the provided action UUID, and PUTs it back — so operators pressing that button immediately reach the emergency broadcast. Pair with 7.11b to restore normal operations on disarm.

actions.message: Paging console slot 1 updated to Emergency All-Call (alarm armed at {{timestamp}})
